claude-code.rationale: Four agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) with several model-provider routes; Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are bundled. Scope: Conductor macOS local workspaces, Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API.

gemini-cli.rationale: The complete first-party harness comparison lists only Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode; no generic harness adapter is documented.

byo-subscription.rationale: Claude subscription or CLI login, Codex sign-in including Sign in with ChatGPT (0.89.0), Cursor subscription for cloud workspaces (0.85.0); Cloud accepts subscriptions. Scope: Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API, Conductor macOS local workspaces.

local.rationale: Cloud FAQ: "Local workspace sessions run on your Mac. If you close the app or shut down your Mac, those sessions end." Cloud doc: after your Mac closes, "Local processes stop". Scope: Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API, Conductor macOS local workspaces.

own-server.rationale: The Cloud FAQ explicitly says own cloud machines are not supported yet.

vendor-cloud.rationale: Conductor provisions the managed Vercel workspace and stores Cloud sessions; Cloud access is a prerequisite, and current new-account eligibility was not tested.

worktree.rationale: The Workspaces and branches page explicitly calls each workspace a Git worktree on its own branch. Local worktree separation remains distinct from closing Cloud microVMs.

vm.rationale: Cloud workspaces are explicitly isolated microVM Vercel sandboxes; local worktrees remain separate.

parallel-runs.rationale: Same-workspace sessions documented. Scope: Conductor macOS local workspaces, Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API.

pr-workflow.rationale: Guided Create PR from the diff viewer; 0.86.0: "Open pull requests in Graphite. Choose it under Open pull requests in Settings → Git". Scope: Conductor macOS local workspaces, Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API.

review-ui.rationale: Diff viewer with unified and per-commit views; files can be edited in diffs (0.84.0). Scope: Conductor Cloud through macOS app and API.

android.rationale: Current complete client selector lists macOS, iOS and API, and omits this client option.

mobile-web.rationale: Current complete client selector lists macOS, iOS and API, and omits this client option.

ios.rationale: The iOS client is offered. Local work requires experimental Remote Control with a paired Mac open, awake and online; Cloud eligibility is separate.

web-client.rationale: Current complete client selector lists macOS, iOS and API, and omits this client option.

cli.rationale: Product-owned Conductor CLI is bundled in cloud workspaces and shown in the API cookbook; limited command documentation, not an underlying agent CLI.

multiplayer.rationale: First-party Cloud collaboration explicitly permits teammates prompting agents together in real time; preserve Cloud/account plan scope.

unattended-triggers.rationale: Cloud routines run a saved prompt on schedules or GitHub/webhook events; preserve Pro/Team and Cloud scope.

free-tier.rationale: The current harness reference explicitly calls the application free to use; agent usage remains separate.

starting-price.rationale: Application use is explicitly free, excluding provider and compute charges; no paid Cloud price is inferred.

byok.rationale: The harness reference explicitly bills model usage to the user provider account or API key.

license.rationale: Explicit proprietary platform definition or restricted service access license and reserved vendor ownership; main application scope.

laptop-independent.rationale: The Cloud overview explicitly states agents continue after the laptop closes until sandbox sleep. Scope is managed Cloud, not local Remote Control.

roles.rationale: Named organization admins can configure shared agent keys in addition to the member personal-credential route; documented Cloud organization permission.
